date_note: Sharp's notice is dated 19 Nov; it says the unauthorized access to KARTE happened on 13 Nov.
title: Sharp says COCORO STORE customer data may have leaked via KARTE, up to 3,264,445 records
summary: Sharp's notice of 19 November says a third party accessed KARTE, the marketing tool used by its COCORO STORE online shop, on 13 November. Up to 3,264,445 records may have leaked, as of 15 November: age, date of birth, gender and the KARTE customer ID. Sharp says leaks of name, address and email are not confirmed. It has disabled the KARTE link.
plain: Sharp says a marketing tool used by its online shop was breached, and up to 3,264,445 records with age, birth date, gender and an ID may have leaked.
exec: A breach at supplier KARTE may expose up to 3,264,445 Sharp shop customer records; Sharp says it will respond under Japan's data protection law.
action: COCORO STORE customers: Sharp asks you to be careful of suspicious emails or contact and of URLs you do not recognize.

sources.name: Sharp notice, 19 Nov 2026 (unauthorized access to KARTE)
